query:
The group decided to order pizza. What did Soo-Yeon's response to that decision reveal about her actual position, and what specifically in how she responded signals this — given that she did not object?

Options:
A. Soo-Yeon
B. Nadia
C. Lena
D. Kezia
context:

[2] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:20:00) I'll just have Raj's flatbread.

[5] (about=Soo-Yeon, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:13:00) she has good taste in groups 🙂

[7] (about=Lena, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:10:00) so basically that explains why Nadia didn't push back on Tomasz's Dune ruling even though everyone else was complaining tbh

[14] (about=Soo-Yeon, said_by=Lena, profile, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Lena observes Soo-Yeon ran a successful theory of mind intervention, identifying Felix's barrier and reframing the proposition.
[15] (about=Soo-Yeon, core, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Knew the design angle would land with Felix, framing Azul as a visual design problem to match his background.

[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Group decides to order pizza for the session, with majority vote; Nadia opts out.
[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) Tonight's snack changed from pizza to lighter options: rice crackers, hummus, and mixed nuts.
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Raj, group-interaction, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Food for round two to be decided; Raj brought more flatbreads.
[20] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tomasz, group-interaction, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) House assignments for Dune: Tomasz takes Atreides, Derek takes Harkonnen; Soo-Yeon and Felix still choosing.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Soo-Yeon, group-interaction, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Group decides to play Mysterium as the next game, with Soo-Yeon proposing it and others agreeing.
agent_answer:
**A. Soo-Yeon**

Her actual position was that she still did **not** want pizza and preferred something lighter. She did not object to the group’s pizza decision, but she signaled her real preference by saying:

> “I'll just have Raj's flatbread.”

That shows she accepted the majority decision without agreeing to eat pizza herself. Earlier she had also asked:

> “Can we do something lighter? I had a heavy lunch 😅”

So her non-objection did not mean she changed her mind; it meant she opted for a separate, lighter alternative while letting the group have pizza.

query:
The group discussed the expectation that everyone should bring either a game or food to the annual marathon. What did Nadia's response signal about her actual relationship to this group norm, and how would you know from what she said?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Tomasz
C. Marcus
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:06:00) I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.
[2] (about=Lena, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:05:00) so basically the norm here is bring something, game or food, agreed tbh. one could argue that even the people who brought nothing last year understood this expectation, they just didn't follow through
[3] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:04:00) In my experience the marathon only works when everyone contributes. It is the social contract of a shared day.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-04-20T19:07:00) that totally counts Nadia! honestly a good game pitch is worth more than another bag of chips 😊
[5] (about=Lena, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:10:00) so basically that explains why Nadia didn't push back on Tomasz's Dune ruling even though everyone else was complaining tbh
[6] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:36:00) Thank you. I did not say anything but I noticed that as well.
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:38:00) I did not want to interrupt the game.
[8] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:07:00) Last April. Nadia found that I was one of the few people in the group who owned the base game for that particular series. We played four sessions over six weeks.
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:05:00) Yes. Everyone keep their food away from the card area please.
[10] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2026-03-16T19:21:00) lol ok pizza it is i guess 😅 majority wins. Nadia you want in on the order?
[11] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Explains she did not want to interrupt the game, hence not mentioning the food issue.
[12] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Will bring a game to the marathon but does not participate in food arrangement.
[13] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Thanks Soo-Yeon for flagging the food issue, noting she noticed it as well but did not say anything.
[14] (about=Nadia, said_by=Lena, profile, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Lena suggests that Nadia's lack of pushback on Tomasz's Dune ruling is explained by their shared wargame history.
[15] (about=Nadia, core, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Does not eat during sessions and will not join the pizza order.
[16] (about=Nadia, core, t6 @2026-03-16T19:01:00) Will set up the bird tray for Wingspan and asks everyone to keep food away from the card area.
agent_answer:
**A. Nadia**

Nadia’s response signaled that she **meets the group norm by contributing a game, but opts out of the food side of the arrangement**. She said:  
> “I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.”

So she is not rejecting the “bring something” expectation; she is satisfying it through the **game** option, while explicitly declining to participate in the food arrangement. This is also reflected in the memory that she does not eat during sessions and will not join the pizza order.
